newsitem.title: NORWAY: Shell Norway refinery sets 1996 record throughput.
newsitem.headline: Shell Norway refinery sets 1996 record throughput.

text.p: Norske Shell said on Thursday its Sola refinery near Stavanger on the west coast of Norway set a record throughput in 1996 of 2.5 million tonnes of crude oil.
Production was 12,000 tonnes higher than the previous record set in 1994, Shell said in a company newsletter.
Operational regularity and profitability was better than forecast and operating costs for the 12-month period were under budget, it said.
"That is in spite of the consequences of a maintenance shutdown at the end of 1995 and a lightening strike in November 1996, which both had a negative impact on production," Shell's newsletter said.
